suppliers.name: Oxford City Farm
suppliers.grows: Veg grown by volunteers in the middle of the city

maryam.heading: Hi, I'm Maryam
maryam.text: I grew up around here and I've worked on local farms for years. I've just started Local Roots to get that food onto Cowley tables: grown nearby, with fewer food miles and no plastic, and priced so everyone can eat well. We're brand new, so come and say hello on a Sunday and tell me what you'd like to see on the stall.

name: Local Roots
intro: We are a new Sunday grocery stall at Workshop Cafe. Seasonal veg, eggs and sourdough from farms a short ride away, at a price you pick. No plastic.

tiers.name: Supported
tiers.description: For when money's tight. No questions, ever.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: Covers a fair price to the farmer and the running of the stall.

tiers.name: Solidarity
tiers.description: If you can pay a little more, it keeps the Supported price possible for a neighbour.

location.notes: Cash and card welcome. Bring a bag if you can.
